terminate.title: Terminate {{ref}}?
terminate.body: Terminate ends the session now; if it held a vault checkout the credential is rotated and the checkout released (the rotation runs server-side).
terminate.bodyLinked: Terminate ends the session now, closes its linked JIT grant, and - if it held a vault checkout - rotates the credential and releases the checkout.
terminate.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. terminated from the session hub
terminate.cascadeRotated: checkout released · credential rotated to version {{version}}

stream.heading: Event stream
stream.summary: {{count}} recorded events · {{blocked}} blocked · {{withheld}} withheld by policy
stream.empty: No events recorded yet for {{ref}}. Commands and channel events appear here as they arrive.

watermark.heading: Watermark & protocol overlay
watermark.off: Watermark control is OFF for this session — the payload below stays on file, nothing is painted.
watermark.overlayAwaiting: Protocol-level overlay (RDP/VNC/browser/DB/SSH/file transfer): not connected — pixel injection awaits the gateway (section 27).
watermark.overlayNone: Protocol-level overlay (RDP/VNC/browser/DB/SSH/file transfer): not connected — this session was not brokered through the gateway (gateway off, non-gateway protocol, or target not zone-mapped).
watermark.overlayConnected: Protocol-level overlay: connected — session brokered through gateway node {{node}}; {{injection}}, {{segments}} sealed segment(s) on disk (section 27).
watermark.overlayEnded: Protocol-level overlay: gateway session {{state}}{{endReason}} via node {{node}}; recording retained for playback (section 27).
watermark.injected: credential injected for the session only (the user never sees it)
